name: Memberra
description: Securely connect Jellyfin to the Memberra operator platform.
overview: Pair a Jellyfin server with Memberra for health reporting, event delivery and managed operator workflows.

versions.changelog: Capability-gated messages to active Jellyfin players, with bounded content, active-session validation, durable command receipts and operator-controlled opt-in.
Durable ordered event delivery, outage and restart recovery, active-session reconciliation, explicit protocol and capability negotiation, queue diagnostics, and compatibility-first fail-safes.
Production release for Jellyfin 10.11.x with fixed-endpoint transport hardening, bounded playback state, replay-safe event ingestion and live watch analytics.
